notes.title: Convergence Compulsion is becoming free + Steam Deck news
notes.notes:
So, a while ago, I quietly set the price for this game to $0--turns out setting your game to free on Steam requires a ticket to support. 

I've taken care of that part now, so pretty soon new players should be able to download the game again.

Other than that, I managed to snag a Steam Deck, and so I've been doing a little work to test compatibility. So far, it's looking good. Need to test with some other people though.

If you try this game on Deck, hit me up and tell me how it worked! Here on community, on Twitter, wherever you can!

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: v1.8.0 - New menus! Check them out!
notes.notes:
First update in a while, but here it is: new menus! Check the patch notes here:

https://joedaywalt.games/games/convergence-compulsion/patch-notes

And keep an eye out for a devlog (at the website above) about why the new look, the new URL, and all that stuff.

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: 1.7.X - The Halloween Event has Ended
notes.notes:
[b]UPDATE:[/b] 1.7.1 fixes an uncommon and low-impact error that popped up sometimes during the game's shutdown sequence. Thanks to Eric H. for reporting this!

With version 1.7.0, the [i]Convergence Compulsion[/i] Halloween event is over. I hope you had fun finding all the secrets and smashing pumpkins! Anything you unlocked sticks around forever, but you'll have to get the codes you missed from other players--they'll still work, but you can't find them with the "?" tokens.

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Convergence Compulsion's Halloween Event Begins!
notes.notes:
Today marks the start of the Convergence Compulsion Halloween event. Get it now and unlock a [b]cast of spooky characters[/b] and get to [b]smashing pumpkins![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38290812/ed874a6eca5a7d9168c84951200093b2593438bf.gif[/img]
[i]I’m really happy with the splat sound I found for these.[/i]

[b]There’s also a new music track,[/b] based on a couple of iconic [i]Castlevania[/i] tunes. Anything you unlock—plus the music—stays after the event; the codes, however, can only be found for a limited time!

I hope you have fun! And don’t smash anyone [i]else’s[/i] pumpkins, alright? Thanks for playing!

---

[b]UPDATE:[/b] As of version 1.6.1, the OPTIONS > CHARACTERS menu will start with your current character selected.

notes.title: v1.5.0 Brings some new music!
notes.notes:
Hi again! This weeks release brings mostly one big front-facing change: new music! There's couple of other smaller changes, too. Read about them at the link below. And get ready for the Halloween event with the next update! Cheers!

[url=https://epi.games/devlog/2020/10/15/convergence-compulsion-1.5.0-patch-notes]Convergence Compulsion 1.5.0 Patch Notes[/url]

notes.title: v1.4.0 Brings Treasure and Persistent Secrets!
notes.notes:
After a bit of a delay, v1.4.0 is up and ready for you! One of the big additions is the treasure box, which is a fun, new way to score points that gives you a choice: score a little bit now for a chance at more later, or take the big score now and get no more treasure for the rest of the run.

The other one is the SECRETS menu, which allows you to toggle secrets you’ve previously unlocked without reentering the codes. Along with that, most codes are persistent between runs now.

There’s a couple other changes to note, which you can read about [url=https://epiblitikos.games/devlog/2020/10/01/convergence-compulsion-1.4.0-patch-notes]here[/url].

notes.title: v1.3.4 Some fixes and a music tweak
notes.notes: Hey! Small update this week. Just some bug fixes and new music that plays when the waves crash in vertically! Read about the rest of the changes--and an update on Mac 64-bit support [url=https://epiblitikos.games/devlog/2020/09/17/convergence-compulsion-1.3.4-patch-notes]here[/url].

notes.title: v1.3.0 Brings Untold Secrets!
notes.notes:
This week's update is a big one, but I can't tell you all the details. It's a secret! Quite a few secrets, even! There's more to come, and you can get a head-start on the hunt by joining the mailing list during start-up.

[b]Bug fix v1.3.2:[/b] fixes a crash that can happen when you interact with one of the secrets. Thanks to Kohrek for reporting this one!
[b]Bug fix v1.3.3:[/b] fixes a minor inconvenience where sometimes you'll discover a test secret that has no effect. Thanks to Eric H. for reporting this!

[url=https://epiblitikos.games/devlog/2020/09/10/convergence-compulsion-1.3.0-patch-notes]Full Release Notes[/url].

notes.title: v1.2.2 is now available, with some visual polish for you!
notes.notes:
The update this week is pretty small, just some cosmetic stuff--mostly with power-ups.

Read all about it [url=https://epiblitikos.games/devlog/2020/09/03/convergence-compulsion-1.2.2-patch-notes]here[/url].

notes.title: v1.2.1 is out, fixes a rare control remap crash
notes.notes:
Hey! A small, quick update to the game, 1.2.1, is up now. There was a crash that had effected a small number of players on the CONTROLS menu. [i]No longer![/i] 

If you run into any problems when you play, please, do report them using the [url=https://epiblitikos.games/support]support form[/url] on the website.

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: v1.2.0 is now available!
notes.notes:
This week's patch is now available, including two main changes.

[list]
[*] Steam's F12 screenshot functionality now works in game. Let me see your most crowded fields!
[*] The look of the UI has been cleaned up--bright gradients and cleaner lines on all text and buttons.
[*] All of the library and store images have been updated, to match the cleaner UI look.
[/list]

As always, you can get the full details [url=https://epiblitikos.games/devlog/2020/08/27/convergence-compulsion-1.2.0-patch-notes]in the epi log[/url]. Thanks for over 30 thousand matches!

notes.title: Version 1.1.0 is now available
notes.notes:
Just a couple of front-facing changes this week, though the background work was large. [url=https://epiblitikos.games/devlog/2020/08/13/convergence-compulsion-1.1.0-patch-notes]Full details here.[/url]

* Redid the music and the underlying music system. 
* Added a global wave counter to the [url=https://epiblitikos.games/cc]game's website[/url].

So yeah, boot up the game, send in those wave counts, and... let's hit a 
million? Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Version 1.0.4 is now available
notes.notes:
As noted, the main fix here is D-pad support. You can use your controller's D-pad the same as keyboard keys now, instead of tapping rapidly--as intended.

More details about the other, more minor fixes here: 
https://epiblitikos.games/devlog/2020/07/31/convergence-compulsion-1.0.4-patch-notes

Happy Release Day! And thanks for playing!
